_budgets_note: daily_max_calls resets at UTC midnight. window_max_calls/window_hours is an independent rolling window that does NOT reset at midnight — it mirrors the provider's session window. Omit window_max_calls (or set 0) to leave a model uncapped on that axis; gemini/grok are rate-limited per-minute rather than per-session, so only the session-window CLIs carry one.
